diagnosis: The litigation case controller serializes the lazy-loaded evidenceItems collection on LegalCase without filtering sealed court records or checking counsel clearance on individual evidence items. Opposing counsel can inspect confidential deposition exhibits and sealed discovery items attached to the case.
